text: REST API to create, search, and manage feedback, documents, customers, and product data
quote: Create, search, and manage feedback, documents, customers, and product data through Productboard's REST API.

text: API lets developers route feedback into Productboard from proprietary CRMs and internal tools
quote: Developers and technical teams use it to route feedback from proprietary CRMs, internal tools, and other non-native sources into Productboard

text: List and search endpoints support cursor-based pagination for large result sets
quote: For large result sets, both the list and search endpoints support cursor-based pagination.

text: Feedback can be associated with users and companies and linked to features, components, and hierarchy entities
quote: Associate feedback with users and companies, and connect it to features, components, and other product hierarchy entities.

text: Webhooks API lets you subscribe to events and get real-time notifications on data changes
quote: The Webhooks API allows you to subscribe to events in Productboard and receive real-time notifications when data changes.

text: Integrations can dynamically discover field definitions for more flexible, future-proof builds
quote: These allow your integration to discover field definitions dynamically, making it easier to build flexible, future-proof integrations.

text: Custom integrations can be built to appear and operate directly inside the Productboard UI
quote: Use this to build custom integrations that appear and operate inside the Productboard UI.

text: API supports creating/updating teams, retrieving team details, and managing membership
quote: You can create and update teams, retrieve team details, and manage team membership by adding or removing members.

text: Analytics API exposes usage metrics like feature views, engagement, note processing, insights usage, and board interactions
quote:
You can retrieve metrics related to:

Feature views
User activity and engagement
Note processing trends
Insights usage
Board views and interactions

text: AI agents can be used to add new features, reschedule initiatives, or act on product specs
quote: Now you can use any agent to add new features, reschedule an initiative, or start building off a product specification.

text: Coding agents and AI prototyping tools can access the latest product specifications to start delivery
quote: Access your latest product specifications from coding agents and AI prototyping tools to initiate the product delivery process.

text: Custom driver fields like value, risk, impact, confidence, and effort can be updated to automate prioritization
quote: Update custom drivers and other data fields on features and initiatives (like value, risk, impact, confidence, and effort) to automate prioritization workflows.

text: Features can be added to initiatives, initiatives moved to new releases, and key results created under objectives
quote: Add features to initiatives, move an initiative to a new release, or create key results beneath an objective.

text: Customer context can be shared so only fully-validated features are sent into delivery
quote: Ensure developers are working on what really matters by sharing customer context and only sending fully-validated features into delivery.

text: One searchable repository holds all product requests and feedback from colleagues and customers
quote: Access one searchable repository for all product requests and feedback from colleagues and customers.

text: Insights within feedback are automatically detected and linked to related feature ideas
quote: Productboard automatically detects insights within feedback that can be linked to related feature ideas.

text: Feedback records support full CRUD with tags, owners, source metadata, and customer attribution via API
quote: Create, read, update, delete, and search customer feedback, complete with text content, tags, owners, source metadata, and customer attribution.

text: API v2 adds configuration endpoints describing the shape of workspace data
quote: API v2 introduces a new concept: configuration endpoints that describe the shape of data in your workspace.

text: Jira Integrations API lets you read configured Jira integrations and their connections to Productboard entities
quote: The Jira Integrations API allows you to read the Jira integrations configured in your workspace and inspect their connections to Productboard entities.
